data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the Syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 526.33m (31 Dec 2013). The report states the 2014 net technical result included net releases of GBP 27.7m in respect of prior accident years (a net release after reinsurance). This release is attributed to favourable claims development and the effect of reinsurance recoveries moderating large loss impacts. The Syndicate did experience significant aviation war losses in 2014 (eg MH17 and the Tripoli airport attack) which were largely mitigated by reinsurance programmes; a prior large marine loss (Costa Concordia) from 2012 was noted but had not materially worsened the Syndicate position.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, 2013 comparative column). The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 27.7m for prior accident years (used here as prior_year_development_gbp_m = -27.7). A gross (pre-reinsurance) prior-year movement figure was not provided explicitly in the notes available; therefore the net of reinsurance figure has been used as a fallback. No explicit LOB-level prior year reserve movement amounts or a claims development triangle were found in the provided pages.
